facts.statement: Caelestiventus is a pterosaur genus from the Late Triassic found in western North America.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus ( , meaning "heavenly wind") is a pterosaur genus from the Late Triassic (latest Norian or Rhaetian) found in western North America.

facts.statement: The type species Caelestiventus hanseni honors Robin Hansen, a Bureau of Land Management geologist who helped access the excavation site.
facts.quote: The type species, Caelestiventus hanseni, honors Robin Hansen, the Bureau of Land Management geologist (BLM), who facilitated access to the excavation site.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus fossils were recovered from the Saints & Sinners Quarry in northeastern Utah.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus was recovered from the Saints & Sinners Quarry of northeastern Utah.

facts.statement: The fossil site was discovered in 2007 by Dan Chure and George Engelmann while studying the Nugget Sandstone.
facts.quote: The site was discovered in 2007 by Dan Chure and George Engelmann while working on the geology and paleontology of the fossilized dunes of the Nugget Sandstone.

facts.statement: The discovery of Caelestiventus was reported in scientific literature in 2015.
facts.quote: In 2015 the discovery of Caelestiventus was reported in the scientific literature.

facts.statement: Measurements are based on a single immature specimen, suggesting the adult animal would have been even larger.
facts.quote: These measurements are based on the only known specimen, which had not yet reached full maturity at the time of its death; a full-grown Caelestiventus would have been even larger.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus is known from a single specimen (BYU 20707) preserving most of the skull and the tip of the fourth wing finger.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus is known from a single individual (BYU 20707, in the Museum of Paleontology at Brigham Young University) that preserves much of the skull (skull cap, sides of the face, and a complete lower jaw (mandible) along with a single non-skull bone – the last finger bone at the end of the elongated fourth finger (manual digit IV 4) that supported the tip of the wing.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus belongs to the family Dimorphodontidae.
facts.quote: familia: Dimorphodontidae

facts.statement: Caelestiventus, meaning "sky wind," is an extinct pterosaur genus that lived during the Late Triassic in western North America.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus (nombre que significa "viento del cielo") es un género extinto de pterosaurio el cual vivió durante el Triásico Superior (época del Noriense o Rhaetiense) en el oeste de América del Norte.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus shows that early pterosaurs were morphologically and ecologically diverse and that the Dimorphodontidae originated in the Triassic period.
facts.quote: Adicionalmente, muestra que los primeros pterosaurios fueron morfológica y ecológicamente diversos y que los Dimorphodontidae se originaron durante el período Triásico.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus is the sole example of a non-pterodactyloid pterosaur living in a desert area and is 65 million years older than other pterosaurs that lived in arid zones.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus es importante porque es el único ejemplo de un pterosaurio no pterodactiloide que habitó en un área desértica y es 65 millones de años más antiguo que los otros pterosaurios que vivieron en zonas áridas.

facts.statement: The skull is mostly known, being narrow laterally and very high vertically, similar to Dimorphodon, with an enormous external nostril that was the largest cranial opening.
facts.quote: Se conoce la mayor parte del cráneo. Este es estrecho lateralmente y muy alto en sentido vertical, siendo similar en ese aspecto al de Dimorphodon, con una enorme narina externa que era la mayor de las aberturas craneanas, junto con una gran fenestra anteorbital.

facts.statement: The skull roof has a midline crest and large crests along the medial edges of the upper temporal fenestra, marking attachment points for the jaw-closing muscle.
facts.quote: La bóveda craneana posee una cresta en el medio así como grandes crestas a lo largo de los bordes mediales de la fenestra temporal superior que marcan los puntos de sujeción del músculo que cerraba la mandíbula.

facts.statement: A prominent bump at the back of the skull, the nuchal crest, indicates that large neck muscles were housed there.
facts.quote: Una prominente protuberancia en la parte posterior del cráneo, la cresta nucal, indica que allí se alojaban grandes músculos del cuello.

facts.statement: The unflattened neurocranium allowed the first endocranial reconstruction of a Triassic pterosaur, revealing a brain with large cerebral lobes, bulging optic lobes, and small olfactory lobes.
facts.quote: El neurocráneo sin aplastar permitió la primera reconstrucción endocraneana de un pterosaurio triásico y muestra que el cerebro tenía grandes lóbulos cerebrales, con lóbulos ópticos abultados y pequeños lóbulos olfatorios.

facts.statement: The lower front of the jaw has a keel, and the entire jaw is hollow and likely filled with air, featuring large pneumatic openings at the rear.
facts.quote: La parte inferior del frente de la mandíbula posee una quilla. Tiene grandes aberturas neumáticas en la parte posterior de la mandíbula y la totalidad de esta es hueca y probablemente estaba llena de aire (neumática).

facts.statement: Caelestiventus is heterodont, possessing three types of teeth: long tusk-like teeth, leaf-shaped teeth, and small blades.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus es heterodonto, con dientes de tres formas - largos dientes en forma de colmillo, otros en forma de "hoja", y pequeñas cuchillas.

facts.statement: The two elongated tusks were located near the front of each side of the jaw and possibly opposed similar teeth at the tip of the snout in the premaxilla.
facts.quote: Los colmillos alargados eran dos y se situaban cerca del frente de cada lado de la mandíbula y posiblemente se oponían a unos dientes similares de la punta del hocico (en el premaxilar).

facts.statement: Behind the tusks in the jaw is a toothless section (diastema) followed by 38 tiny teeth on each side of the jaw.
facts.quote: En la mandíbula, tras los colmillos hay una sección sin dientes (diastema) la cual es seguida por 38 diminutos dientes a cada lado de la mandíbula (ramo mandibular).

facts.statement: Each upper jaw in the skull is armed with twelve large triangular leaf-shaped teeth, reinforced on both sides by a central crest and ending in two points (bicuspid).
facts.quote: Entre tanto en el cráneo cada maxilar está armado con doce grandes dientes triangulares en forma de hoja. Ambos lados de los dientes maxilares están reforzados por una cresta central y estos dientes terminan en dos puntas (son bicúspides).

facts.statement: Caelestiventus was recovered from the Saints & Sinners Quarry in northeastern Utah, USA.
facts.quote: Caelestiventus fue recuperado en la Cantera Saints & Sinners al noreste de Utah, en Estados Unidos.

facts.statement: The site was discovered in 2007 by Dan Chure and George Engelmann while working on the geology and paleontology of fossilized dunes in the Nugget Sandstone.
facts.quote: El yacimiento fue descubierto en 2007 por Dan Chure y George Engelmann mientras se encontraban trabajando en la geología y paleontología de las dunas fosilizadas de la Arenisca Nugget.

facts.statement: In 2015, the discovery of a pterosaur skeleton from this area was reported in the scientific literature.
facts.quote: En 2015, se reportó el hallazgo de un esqueleto de pterosaurio de esta área en la literatura científica.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses show that Caelestiventus is the sister taxon of Dimorphodon macronyx within the family Dimorphodontidae, defined by Britt and colleagues as the least inclusive clade containing Caelestiventus hanseni and Dimorphodon macronyx.
facts.quote: Los análisis filogenéticos muestran que Caelestiventus es el taxón hermano de Dimorphodon macronyx dentro de la familia Dimorphodontidae, la cual fue definida por Britt y colaboradores como el clado menos inclusivo que abarca a Caelestiventus hanseni y Dimorphodon macronyx, los únicos dos géneros considerados como dimorfodóntidos en sus análisis.

facts.statement: Caelestiventus lived from the Carnian to the Toarcian stages, between 237 and 174.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Toarcian (237 to 174.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of Caelestiventus has been recorded.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 1

facts.statement: Besides Caelestiventus, the Saints & Sinners Quarry has produced a diverse vertebrate fauna including two genera of sphenosuchians, two genera of sphenodonts, a drepanosaurid, a procolophonid, and two theropod dinosaurs – a coelophysoid and a medium-sized genus represented only by teeth.
facts.quote: Además de Caelestiventus, la cantera Saints & Sinners ha producido una diversa fauna de vertebrados que incluye a dos géneros de esfenosuquios, dos géneros de esfenodontes, un drepanosáurido, un procolofónido y dos dinosaurios terópodos – un celofisoideo y un género de tamaño mediano solo representado por dientes.
